chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed at the Standing Place in a robe by which he will be gladdened."

key_terms.حُلَّةً: a robe or garment of honor
key_terms.عَزَّى: offered consolation to someone afflicted with grief
key_terms.ٱلْمَوْقِفِ: the standing place on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for consoling a grieving person in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages consoling those who are sorrowful and presents it as a virtuous social act. It promises a reward in the Hereafter, where the one who comforts the grieving will be honored on the Day of Judgment.
